messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: inference.p99 latency > 4s and streaming stall rate increased to 2.3% across us-west1/us-east1. Triggered paging to oncall.
mia: saw the alert, jumping in — are we seeing auth failures or DB slowness?
devin: I'm oncall, looking at dashboards now. p95 ~ 600ms, p99 spiking to 4.8s for streaming start-on-first-token. Non-streamed gen p99 also elevated but less frequent.
samir: initial traces show long waits on configfetch and token-store during request init. configstore latencies up, and a small spike of 502s from auth-proxy.
rachel: customers reporting partial streams (start token then stall) and long tail latency for short prompts. Support already flagged 3 paying customers.mia: ok, throttle? rate-limit service returning 429s? or auth token fetches timing out?
devin: rate-limit 5xx/429 counts up ~3x baseline. auth token store shows elevated read latency (avg read 320ms -> 1.6s p99). configfetch calls to configstore show tail spikes at ~1.2s p99 but some outliers at 3s.
ops-bot: Related metrics:
- inference.gateway: p99 4.8s
- configstore.read.p99 3.0s
- token-store.read.p99 1.6s
- featureflags.fetch.5xx count +120 in last 10m
mia: thanks. Let's run quick hit list: 1) fallback configs? 2) increase auth token TTL if possible so less reads 3) route traffic off stressed region 4) temp relax strict rate-limits for internal control-plane calls 5) enable KV cache for featureflags.
samir: I can push a configcache fallback to edge-kv for config keys — that will reduce configstore reads for 60s TTL. Doing a small patch now.
devin: I'll open the oncall bridge and take ownership. Working through runbook -> set priority P1, customer-impact high (partial streams). @rachel please notify affected customers that we're investigating.
rachel: pinged customers, repeating status: "Investigating elevated inference latency and streaming stalls; mitigation in progress." Will update in 30m or on significant change.
mia: Devin, runbook step 3 — can you flip model fallback to the older quantized variant for hosted api to reduce memory/KV pressure on runtime? That might avoid long-tail decode stalls.
devin: Doing canary redirect of 10% to q4-legacy variant for a subset of sessions. Command:
```bash
# redirect 10% traffic for hosted-api -> q4-legacy model
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://console.internal/api/traffic-shift \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"q4-legacy","percent":10}'
```
ops-bot: traffic shift accepted, canary started.
samir: pushed configcache fallback to edge-kv, keys now return cached response for 30s TTL. Monitor configstore read rate.
devin: configstore read QPS dropped ~40% in last 30s. token-store reads still heavy, but auth failures decreased from 502-> 200s for retries.
mia: any evidence of upstream DB causing this? high CPU/connection pool exhaustion?
samir: DB metrics show increased connection wait time on token-store readers; might be thundering under sustained bursts. We should add connection pool backpressure and retry jitter as longer-term fix.
devin: short-term mitigation: increase token cache TTL in runtime from 5s -> 30s (hotfix). Applying to hosted runtime config for us-west1.
ops-bot: hotfix deployed to us-west1 runtime config at 3976543345, token TTL -> 30s.
rachel: customer update sent: "We've deployed mitigations including temporary caching and traffic canaries. Streaming should stabilize; we'll continue monitoring and provide updates." :thumbsup:
mia: good. Next: reduce configfetch frequency from control-plane to 1s min for identical request keys (avoid fanout) — Samir can you add coalesce in the proxy?
samir: adding coalesce logic to control-plane proxy now. Will route duplicate concurrent requests to single inflight fetch for same key.
devin: after these changes p99 for inference dropped to ~2.1s within 3 minutes, streaming stall rate down to 0.6%. Not fully back to baseline but improving.
mia: excellent. Keep monitoring for 30m, prepare a postmortem. Samir owns root cause analysis (featureflags/configstore hotkey + token-store connection exhaustion). Devin to lead immediate incident writeup and customer comms.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created INC-2026 with severity P1, owner: devin, postmortem owner: samir.
rachel: note for follow-up: evaluate fallback behavior for featureflags to avoid on-path blocking of streaming start. Also review rate-limit thresholds for control-plane calls so internal traffic can't cause SLO regressions for inference.
samir: agree. follow-ups: 1) featureflags local cache at edge 2) token-store connection pool sizing 3) coalesce inflight configfetches 4) better observability for request head tail times.
mia: ok team — handoff to post-incident run. Devin, please do final status update in 15m and hand back to regular oncall when stabilized.
devin: will do. current status: Mitigations applied, partial recovery. Continuing watch. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: This thread will be archived after incident status set to resolved.
